# SBI Foundation

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Budget spent (10 searches, multiple document reads) after covering identity, identifiers, two fiscal years of programme/spend detail, partners, footprints, metrics, one contact and two documents. Remaining gaps: SBI Foundation's own PAN/CSR-1/Darpan IDs; a Section-135-style prescribed/spent/unspent statutory table for the Foundation itself (that obligation and its Companies Act annexure sits in State Bank of India the bank's own books, a separate entity, and no such annexure was even found in SBI's own FY2024/FY2025 annual reports); the exact disbursed amount for the existing KABIL/Jaldhara grant; a named individual CSR/grants contact; SBI Foundation's own separately published annual report (listed on Scribd, unreadable per robots.txt); a foundation-wide (as opposed to single-RFP) statement of grant size range, duration and eligibility criteria; and impact-assessment disclosure for Foundation programmes.

SBI Foundation is confirmed as the Section 8 (non-profit) company established by State Bank of India (CIN U85100MH2015NPL266051, incorporated 26 Jun 2015) to run the Bank's CSR programmes. Verified via SBI's own FY2023-24 and FY2024-25 Annual Reports that it operates flagship verticals -- Gram Seva, Youth for India Fellowship, Centre of Excellence for PwDs, Jivanam (healthcare), Sashakti (women), Integrated Learning Mission (education), LEAP (livelihoods), ACE (sports) and CONSERW (environment, parent of the already-recorded Jaldhara programme) -- with detailed per-vertical project counts, sanctioned budgets and named partner NGOs for both years. In FY2024-25 SBI Foundation funded 180 projects worth Rs 485.83 crore and disbursed Rs 264.00 crore. SBI (the bank)'s own Section 135 CSR spend (e.g. Rs 610.77 crore total CSR expenditure in FY2024-25) is a separate set of books from the Foundation's and was deliberately NOT attributed to this funder record. A third-party RFP summary (Skillspedia) gave one concrete example of grant terms: Rs 50 lakh-Rs 3 crore per project, 1-3 year duration, for a specific Integrated Learning Mission RFP, plus an RFP submission email; this is not confirmed as the Foundation's general policy.

Website: https://sbifoundation.in

## What it set out to find

- identity: legal name, registration type, parent relationship to SBI, website, funder type
- identifiers: CIN, PAN, CSR-1, domain
- csr_year: SBI (bank) prescribed/spent/overhead/unspent per FY, and SBI Foundation's own disclosed budget/spend
- csr_spend: project/aggregate level detail across SBI Foundation verticals
- footprint: states/districts where projects actually ran
- stated_geography: declared priority areas from CSR policy
- partner: named implementing NGOs/agencies per programme per FY
- grant: recipient, title, amount, dates, status
- program: theme > programme > phase > project hierarchy
- metric: beneficiary counts/outputs with stage and method
- contact: publicly disclosed CSR/grants contact
- document: annual report, CSR policy, CSR annexure
- extra: grant size range, duration, direct-funding vs own-ops, eligibility, application process, RFP status, Schedule VII mapping, recent named grants
